mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0 occurs, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) triggers aggressive monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition (CPIAUCSL > 235 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5) occurs, but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 440000 and HOUST > 1150), housing starts below 1150 signal weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In strong consumer demand periods (RSAFS > 440000 and HOUST > 1150), HOUST < 1150 occurs but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates strengthening supply conditions, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100 occurs, but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 240 signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240 occurs, but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition (UNRATE > 5.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5) occurs, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 140000), employment decline (PAYEMS < 140000) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In tight labor market periods (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 140000), PAYEMS < 140000 occurs but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
